label: Localized text
summary: A function on a portrait type group that takes one argument and returns a text.
details: Going by its name, it turns the argument (a localization key) into the text of the current language. Vanilla never names it on this type; the global Localize( … ) used in legend texts is a different function and only a hint.

label: Portrait type group itself
summary: A function on a portrait type group that hands back the object itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types, such as Character.Self, are only a hint.

label: Access agent window itself
summary: A function on the potential agent window (the window that lists characters who could join a scheme as agents) that hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf, which passes a widget along, is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Close agent window
summary: Closes the potential agent window of a scheme.
details: Vanilla calls it from the close button of the potential scheme agent window. It returns nothing.

label: Agent slot type
summary: The kind of agent slot the potential agent window is filling.
details: Vanilla shows its name in the window header ("Potential …") and its description in the window text, so the slot type is the agent role being looked for.

label: Contribution type icon
summary: The icon of the contribution type shown for each candidate in the potential agent window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the texture of a small icon in each candidate row, next to a number taken from the row's own 'contribution' value. The game documents nothing more about what the contribution is.

label: Candidate list
summary: The list of candidates shown in the potential agent window.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data of the character list in the potential scheme agent window, and again for that window's character filter. Going by the list's name, the rows are characters who could become agents.

label: Has agents
summary: Whether the potential agent window has any agents (yes or no).
details: Going by its name, it tells if there are agents to show. Vanilla never names it on this type; SchemeItem.HasAgents in the intrigue window is a different type and only a hint.

label: Agent window itself
summary: A function on the potential agent window that hands back the window itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access building option itself
summary: A function on a potential building item (a building that could be built, as listed in the domicile window) that hands back the object itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: AI build weight
summary: A number for how much the AI wants to build this domicile building.
details: Vanilla shows it only in a debug tooltip of the domicile window ("AI will build: …"). Going by that and its name, it is the AI's weight for choosing this building.

label: Building
summary: The domicile building this building option stands for.
details: Vanilla passes it on as the data of parts of the domicile window and checks IsRootOfTrack on it (the game does not explain that term; going by the name, it is about the building's upgrade track).

label: Construction time
summary: The time it takes to build this domicile building, as a value with its breakdown.
details: Vanilla passes it to a text that shows the value and its breakdown in the domicile window. The game documents no return type.

label: Gold cost
summary: The gold cost of building this domicile building, as a value with its breakdown.
details: Vanilla shows it in the domicile window only when HasGoldCost is true. The game documents no return type.

label: Herd cost
summary: The herd cost (herd is the nomads' resource of livestock) of building this domicile building, as a value with its breakdown.
details: Vanilla shows it in the domicile window only when HasHerdCost is true. The game documents no return type.

label: Influence cost
summary: The influence cost (influence is the resource of administrative realms) of building this domicile building, as a value with its breakdown.
details: Vanilla shows it in the domicile window only when HasInfluenceCost is true. The game documents no return type.

label: Internal buildings list
summary: A text listing the internal buildings of this domicile building.
details: Vanilla shows it as the tooltip of an icon that appears when the building is not an internal one and HasInternalUpgrades is true. Going by its name and that use, it lists the internal buildings that belong to this one.

label: Piety cost
summary: The piety cost of building this domicile building, as a value with its breakdown.
details: Vanilla shows it in the domicile window only when HasPietyCost is true. The game documents no return type.

label: Prestige cost
summary: The prestige cost of building this domicile building, as a value with its breakdown.
details: Vanilla shows it in the domicile window only when HasPrestigeCost is true. The game documents no return type.

label: Treasury cost
summary: The treasury cost of building this domicile building, as a value with its breakdown.
details: Vanilla shows it in the domicile window only when HasTreasuryCost is true. The game documents no return type.

label: Has gold cost
summary: Whether building this domicile building costs gold (yes or no).
details: Vanilla uses it to show the gold cost line only when there is one.

label: Has herd cost
summary: Whether building this domicile building costs herd (yes or no).
details: Vanilla uses it to show the herd cost line only when there is one.

label: Has influence cost
summary: Whether building this domicile building costs influence (yes or no).
details: Vanilla uses it to show the influence cost line only when there is one.

label: Has internal upgrades
summary: Whether this domicile building has internal upgrades (yes or no).
details: Vanilla shows a part of the domicile window when this is true and the building itself is not an internal one.

label: Has piety cost
summary: Whether building this domicile building costs piety (yes or no).
details: Vanilla uses it to show the piety cost line only when there is one.

label: Has prestige cost
summary: Whether building this domicile building costs prestige (yes or no).
details: Vanilla uses it to show the prestige cost line only when there is one.

label: Has treasury cost
summary: Whether building this domicile building costs treasury (yes or no).
details: Vanilla uses it to show the treasury cost line only when there is one.

label: Building option itself
summary: A function on a potential building item that hands back the object itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access contributor window itself
summary: A function on the potential contributor window (the window listing who could contribute to a great project) that hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Close contributor window
summary: Closes the window of potential great project contributors.
details: Vanilla calls it from the close button of that window. It returns nothing.

label: Contributor list
summary: The list of potential contributors shown in the great project contributor window.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data of the list in that window, so each row is a possible contributor.

label: Contributor window itself
summary: A function on the potential contributor window that hands back the window itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access candidate list itself
summary: A function on the list of potential councillors that hands back the list itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Candidate's merit
summary: The merit entry (merit is a character's merit level, which administrative realms use to decide who can gain provinces) of one candidate in the list of potential councillors, picked by the row's number.
details: Vanilla passes the row's index (CharacterListItem.GetIndex) in the potential councillor window. Going by the name, it is the merit entry for that candidate. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: the row index, as vanilla passes CharacterListItem.GetIndex

label: Candidate list itself
summary: A function on the list of potential councillors that hands back the list itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access councillor window itself
summary: A function on the potential councillor window (the window where you pick someone for a council seat) that hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Can fire councillor
summary: Whether the current holder of the council seat can be fired (yes or no).
details: Vanilla enables the fire and assign buttons of the potential councillor window with it, and picks the button's tooltip by it: the assign tooltip when firing is possible, the fire tooltip (the reason) when it is not.

label: Can reassign councillor
summary: Whether the councillor can be reassigned from this window (yes or no).
details: Vanilla shows one part of the potential councillor window when this is true and another when it is false. Going by its name, it is about moving the councillor to a different seat; the game documents nothing more.

label: Close councillor window
summary: Closes the potential councillor window.
details: Vanilla calls it from the close button of that window. It returns nothing.

label: Fire councillor
summary: Fires the councillor who holds the council seat shown in the window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button of the potential councillor window. It returns nothing. Whether firing is allowed is checked with CanFireCouncillor.

label: Candidate list
summary: The list of characters shown as candidates in the potential councillor window.
details: Vanilla passes it on as the data of the list part of that window. The game documents no return type.

label: Seat's skill
summary: The skill item (the main skill) of the council seat in this window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of the skill icon in the window's header, shown only when HasMainSkill is true. It returns a skill item.

label: Council position
summary: The council position (the seat, such as chancellor or spymaster) the window is choosing someone for.
details: Vanilla passes it on as the data of a part of the potential councillor window.

label: Current councillor
summary: The character who holds the council seat shown in the window now.
details: Vanilla passes it on as the data of a part of the potential councillor window; HasCouncillor tells whether the seat is filled.

label: Councillor's skills
summary: The skills of the current councillor, as a list for the window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of a repeated list in the potential councillor window. Going by its name, it lists the councillor's skills. The game documents no return type.

label: Fire councillor tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of the button that fires the current councillor.
details: Vanilla shows it on the fire button, and on the assign button when CanFireCouncillor is false, where it explains why the councillor cannot be replaced.

label: Councillor's merit
summary: The merit entry (merit is a character's merit level, which administrative realms use to decide who can gain provinces) shown in the potential councillor window.
details: Vanilla passes it on as the data of a part of that window. Going by its name, it is the current councillor's merit; the game documents no return type.

label: Potential councillor list
summary: The list of potential councillors behind the window.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data of a large part of the potential councillor window; PotentialCouncillorList.GetMeritItem is also used inside the window.

label: Potential councillors
summary: A function on the potential councillor window; going by its name, the possible councillors for the seat.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Sort options
summary: A function on the potential councillor window; going by its name, the ways the candidate list can be sorted.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; ArtifactClaimsList.GetSortOptions, used for the list of a sorting menu, is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Has councillor
summary: Whether the council seat in the window is filled right now (yes or no).
details: Vanilla uses it to show the parts of the potential councillor window about the current councillor.

label: Has main skill
summary: Whether the council seat in the window has a main skill (yes or no).
details: Vanilla shows a part of the potential councillor window only when this is true. Going by its name, it tells if the seat is tied to one skill.

label: Has candidates
summary: Whether the potential councillor window has anyone in its list (yes or no).
details: Vanilla shows a part of the window when this is false, so it covers the case of an empty candidate list.

label: Has pending interaction
summary: Whether a given candidate already has an interaction waiting for an answer (yes or no).
details: Vanilla passes the row's character (CharacterListItem.GetCharacter) and disables that candidate's buttons while this is true.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character, as vanilla passes CharacterListItem.GetCharacter

label: Is councillor powerful
summary: Whether the current councillor is powerful (yes or no), going by its name.
details: Vanilla never uses it. Going by the name, it is about the councillor being a powerful vassal; the game documents nothing more.

label: Is relevant skill
summary: Whether a given skill matters for the council seat in the window (yes or no), going by its name.
details: It takes one argument, by its name a skill. Vanilla never uses it; the game documents nothing more.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Going by the name, the skill to check.

label: Councillor window itself
summary: A function on the potential councillor window that hands back the window itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access elector itself
summary: A function on a potential elector (going by its name, a character who could vote in a title's election) that hands back the object itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Current nomination
summary: A function on a potential elector; going by its name, the candidate this elector is nominating now.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Elector
summary: A function on a potential elector; going by its name, the elector character.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; SuccessionElectionElector.GetElector in the title election window is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Vote chance
summary: A whole number on a potential elector; going by its name, the chance that this elector votes a certain way.
details: Vanilla never uses it, so whose vote it is about is not shown.

label: Elector itself
summary: A function on a potential elector that hands back the object itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access faction window itself
summary: A function on the potential faction member window (the window listing who could join a faction) that hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Close faction member window
summary: Closes the window of potential faction members.
details: Vanilla calls it from the close button of that window. It returns nothing.

label: Potential member list
summary: The list of characters shown in the potential faction member window.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data of the list in that window, so each row is a character who could join the faction.

label: Has potential members
summary: Whether the potential faction member window has anyone to list (yes or no), going by its name.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PotentialCouncillorWindow.HasMembers, used to show a part for an empty list, is a different type and only a hint.

label: Faction window itself
summary: A function on the potential faction member window that hands back the window itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access task location itself
summary: A function on the task location window (the map panel for picking where a councillor carries out a task) that hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Close task location window
summary: Closes the panel for picking a council task's location.
details: Vanilla calls it from a close button in the council window. It returns nothing.

label: Accept tooltip
summary: A text on the task location window; going by its name, the tooltip of the button that confirms the chosen location.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Active council task
summary: The council task whose location is being picked in this panel.
details: Vanilla uses it to name the councillor's position in the panel ("Your …", "… Task") and to reach the councillor doing the task.

label: Council task type
summary: The type of council task whose location is being picked.
details: Vanilla shows its name in the panel and uses it to reach the council position the task belongs to.

label: Window title
summary: A text on the task location window; going by its name, its title text.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the many GetTitle… lines elsewhere belong to other types and are only a hint.

label: Is location selected
summary: Whether a location has been chosen in the task location window (yes or no), going by its name.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Select location
summary: An action on the task location window; going by its name, it chooses the location for the council task.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla never names it on this type; lines with "Select" elsewhere are texts or other types and only a hint.

label: Task location itself
summary: A function on the task location window that hands back the window itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access mask preview itself
summary: A function on a preview mask texture (going by its name, a mask image shown as a preview) that hands back the object itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Mask opacity
summary: A decimal number: how opaque (not see-through) the map editor's preview mask is, from 0 to 1.
details: The engine's map editor shows it as the value of a slider running from 0 to 1 and in an edit box beside it.

label: Mask preview itself
summary: A function on a preview mask texture that hands back the object itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Set mask opacity
summary: Sets the opacity of the map editor's preview mask from the slider it is attached to; it returns nothing.
details: The map editor calls it whenever the opacity slider (0 to 1) changes. It takes no argument, so the value comes from the slider.

label: Set mask opacity from text
summary: Sets the opacity of the map editor's preview mask from the edit box it is attached to; it returns nothing.
details: The map editor calls it when editing of the opacity box beside the slider is finished. It takes no argument, so the value comes from the box's text.

label: Access contract itself
summary: A function on a vassal's primary contract and obligation (the main terms an administrative vassal serves under) that hands back the object itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Obligation level
summary: The level of the vassal's primary obligation, going by its name.
details: Vanilla passes it on as the data of parts of the administrative vassal detail window and of the government administration window, next to the primary contract and obligation of an administrative title. The game documents no return type.

label: Obligation options
summary: The obligation options of the vassal's primary contract, as a list.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of a list in the administrative vassal detail window, whose entries show a contract type and an obligation level. The game documents no return type.

label: Contract type
summary: A function on a primary contract and obligation; going by its name, its type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; lines such as TASK_CONTRACT.GetType belong to other types and are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Contract itself
summary: A function on a primary contract and obligation that hands back the object itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access progress itself
summary: A function on a progress interface (the progress of a loading step) that hands back the object itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Progress text
summary: The progress of loading, as a text.
details: Vanilla shows it on the loading screen when a save is loaded.

label: Progress itself
summary: A function on a progress interface that hands back the object itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access contribution type itself
summary: A function on a project contribution type (one kind of contribution to a great project) that hands back the object itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Can show contribution
summary: Whether this great project contribution can be shown (yes or no), going by its name.
details: It takes two arguments the game does not describe. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Name
summary: The name of the great project contribution type.
details: Vanilla shows it as the header of a contribution's tooltip in great project texts.

label: Contribution name
summary: The name of a great project contribution type, as plain text without a tooltip.
details: Vanilla's great project texts use it for a contribution's name.

label: Preview tooltip
summary: A tooltip text that previews this great project contribution, taking one argument.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; ContributionItem.GetPreviewTooltip in the great project window is a different type and only a hint. What the argument is is not documented.

label: Is required
summary: Whether this contribution is required for the great project (yes or no), going by its name.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; ActivitySpecialGuestType.IsRequired is a different type and only a hint.

label: Contribution type itself
summary: A function on a project contribution type that hands back the object itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access house member list itself
summary: A function on the list of prominent house members (in the government administration window) that hands back the list itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Member's merit
summary: The merit entry (merit is a character's merit level, which administrative realms use to decide who can gain provinces) of one house member in the list, picked by the row's number.
details: Vanilla passes the row's index (CharacterListItem.GetIndex) in the government administration window. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: the row index, as vanilla passes CharacterListItem.GetIndex

label: Member's merit pools
summary: The merit pools of one house member in the list, picked by the row's number.
details: Vanilla passes the row's index, shows the pools as a list, shows another part when the list is empty, and changes the layout when there are four or more. Going by the name, these are the sources the member's merit comes from.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: the row index, as vanilla passes CharacterListItem.GetIndex

label: House member list itself
summary: A function on the list of prominent house members that hands back the list itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access appointment group itself
summary: A function on a group of appointments in the government administration window that hands back the group itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Group title
summary: The heading text of a group of appointments in the government administration window.
details: Vanilla shows it above the group's entries in the view that lists provinces a house member can be appointed to (headings such as "Active Candidacy" and "Possible Appointments").

label: Group entries
summary: The entries of a group of appointments, as a list.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of the list under the group's heading; each entry is a ProminentThemeItem (one title open for appointment).

label: Appointment group itself
summary: A function on a group of appointments that hands back the group itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access appointment itself
summary: A function on an appointment entry (one title a house member could be appointed to, in the government administration window) that hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Candidate
summary: The candidate shown for this appointment entry.
details: Vanilla passes it on as the data of a part of the entry in the government administration window. Going by its name, it is the character in line for the title; the game documents no return type.

label: Levies
summary: The levies (soldiers raised from the land) that come with this appointment's title.
details: Vanilla shows it with a soldier icon in the appointment list as a whole number.

label: Succession line text
summary: A text about the line of succession for this appointment's title.
details: Vanilla shows it in the appointment entry. The game's texts for it say how much appointment score is needed to be first and the current position in line, or that you have no candidate in line.

label: Taxes
summary: The taxes (gold income) that come with this appointment's title.
details: Vanilla shows it with a gold icon in the appointment list, with two decimals.

label: Title
summary: The title this appointment entry is for.
details: Vanilla passes it on as the data of a part of the entry in the government administration window. The game documents no return type.

label: Title prominence
summary: The prominence of this appointment's title, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the appointment entry with two decimals. The game does not explain what prominence measures.

label: Has player candidate
summary: Whether the player has a candidate for this appointment (yes or no), going by its name.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Player candidate first
summary: Whether the player's candidate is first in line for this appointment (yes or no), going by its name.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Player self first
summary: A yes-or-no check on an appointment entry; going by its name, whether the player personally stands first in line.
details: Vanilla never uses it. What "independent" means here is not documented.

label: Player has invested
summary: Whether the player has invested in this appointment (yes or no), going by its name.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Player backs top candidate
summary: Whether the player has invested in the leading candidate for this appointment (yes or no), going by its name.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Has valid successor
summary: Whether this appointment's title has a valid successor (yes or no), going by its name.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Is assigned
summary: Whether this appointment is assigned (yes or no), going by its name.
details: Vanilla never uses it, so to whom is not shown.

label: Appointment itself
summary: A function on an appointment entry that hands back the entry itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Lines with Self on other types are only a hint.

label: Access province itself

details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0

label: Barony name

label: Barony name, no tooltip
summary: The name of the barony of this province as plain text, with no tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it for where a regiment is stationed and in artifact names.

label: Barter goods needed
summary: How many barter goods it takes to barter with the holding in this province.
details: Vanilla shows it in the barter window and its texts, which say an army trades that many goods.

label: Clerical conversion text
summary: A text on a province; going by its name, about it being converted within a clerical region.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the map mode tooltips that mention clerical regions use other functions and are only a hint.

label: Clerical region holder
summary: A function on a province; going by its name, the character who holds the clerical region it lies in.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type directly, but the faith window calls GetClericalRegionHolder on the player's capital location, which is likely a province; that is a hint, not proof. The game documents no return type.

label: Converting region holder
summary: A function on a province; going by its name, the clerical region holder who is converting it.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Coat of arms title

label: County
summary: The county this province belongs to.
details: Vanilla reaches the county's faith through it in memory texts, for example the faith of a founded cathedral.

label: County capital province
summary: A function on a province; going by its name, the capital province of its county.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type directly; the county view calls it on HoldingView.GetProvince, which is likely a province, a hint only. The game documents no return type.

label: Culture
summary: A function on a province; going by its name, the culture of the province.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; GetCulture on characters and domiciles is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Danger type
summary: The danger type of this province for a given travel plan, going by its name.
details: Vanilla passes the travel plan data (TravelPlanData.Self) in the travel part of the character event window and uses the result as data there. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The travel plan to check against.
fields.values: travel plan data, as vanilla passes TravelPlanData.Self

label: Danger value
summary: How dangerous this province is for a given travel plan, as a number.
details: Vanilla subtracts the travel plan's safety value from it and shows a part of the event window when the result is zero or more, so danger at or above safety is flagged.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The travel plan to check against.
fields.values: a travel plan, as vanilla passes TravelPlan.Self

label: Domiciles
summary: The domiciles (homes of landless characters, such as camps or estates) in this province, as a list.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of map icons, once with the first entries skipped (starting after a valid domicile index worked out elsewhere).

label: Dynastic cycle map tooltip
summary: A text on a province; going by its name, its tooltip in the dynastic cycle map mode.
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle map mode tooltip calls GetDynasticCycleMapModeTooltip on ROOT.Province, which is likely this function, a hint only.

label: End of recent looting
summary: The date until which the holding in this province counts as recently raided or bartered with.
details: Vanilla shows it in map tooltips: the holding cannot be raided, or bartered with, again until that date.

label: Epidemic map tooltip
summary: A text on a province; going by its name, its tooltip in the epidemics map mode.
details: Vanilla's epidemics map mode tooltip calls GetEpidemicMapTooltip on ROOT.Province, which is likely this function, a hint only.

label: Epidemic resistance
summary: How well this province resists epidemics, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it with an epidemic icon in the holding view and in the infection rate tooltip of the epidemics window.

label: Epidemics
summary: A function on a province; going by its name, the epidemics in it.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Expected conversion date
summary: A function on a province; going by its name, the date it is expected to be converted within its clerical region.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Holy site faiths
summary: A text on a province; going by its name, the faiths that have a holy site in its holding.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type directly; the county view shows it as a tooltip on HoldingView.GetProvince, likely a province, and hides it when the text is empty. That is a hint only.

label: Fort level
summary: The fort level of this province, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it on map icons and checks in the ledger whether it is zero or above zero.

label: Fort level tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains this province's fort level.
details: Vanilla shows it in the county view, the raid window and the siege window.

label: Main epidemic
summary: The epidemic that ranks highest among those in this province.
details: Vanilla names it in the epidemics map mode tooltip, where clicking selects that epidemic.

label: Main legend
summary: The legend that ranks highest among those spreading in this province.
details: Vanilla names it in the legends map mode tooltip, where clicking selects that legend.

label: Holding
summary: The holding (castle, city, temple or other) in this province.
details: Vanilla reaches the holding's special building through it, for example in travel point of interest tooltips and on map icons.

label: Province ID
summary: The province's ID number, a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the map's debug tooltip ("ID: ...") next to the province's tag.

label: Illustration
summary: The picture that illustrates this province.
details: Vanilla uses it as the image of the raid window and the travel route editor. The game documents no return type.

label: Legend map tooltip
summary: A text on a province; going by its name, its tooltip in the legends map mode.
details: Vanilla's legends map mode tooltip calls GetLegendMapTooltip on ROOT.Province, which is likely this function, a hint only.
